target_customer: Teams and developers who want open source business apps running in their own Cloudflare account
problem: SaaS tools are expensive and closed, and self-hosting open source apps is hard to secure and operate.
business_model: Open source apps with a managed hosting service planned from 10 dollars per month plus usage
product_category: Open source SaaS alternative hosting platform

founders.name: Ben Senescu
founders.background_notes: YC page: senior software engineer at Klaviyo and a former founding engineer building compliance agents. A Northeastern Khoury profile may give education but could not be opened because of a rate limit.

competitors.name: Semrush and Ahrefs
competitors.what: Paid SEO suites that OpenSEO positions against

competitors.name: Wispr Flow and Granola
competitors.what: Closed apps that OpenScribe positions as open source alternatives to

technical_complexity.rationale: A gateway with secrets isolation on Cloudflare Workers plus several apps is moderate engineering, helped by agent coding tools.

defensibility.rationale: Open source code can be forked by anyone; any edge is community and the hosting convenience.

market_need_then: OpenSEO reportedly has 24,000+ GitHub stars per the company (other trackers show lower or older counts), indicating demand for open source SEO tools. Platform demand is unproven since an earlier January version lacked apps.

identity.voice_and_tone: Ownership pitch: 'Make every app open source'; apps use an Open prefix (OpenSEO, OpenCRM, OpenScribe).

branding.community_and_virality: OpenSEO trended on GitHub (reported number 3 on June 28, 2026) and had Product Hunt launches; star counts vary by tracker.

brand_strength.rationale: Exact .com and a consistent Open naming family with real GitHub community traction, though the sub-brand OpenSEO outshines EveryApp.

pivots.to: Lead with standalone OpenSEO, then return to the platform
pivots.why: Founder says the January launch lacked useful apps, per a search summary of a Northeastern profile that could not be opened.

outcome_analysis: EveryApp is a Fall 2026 company that gained traction through the open source OpenSEO project and now sells a hosted platform around it. No outcome yet. Strength is real community pull; the risk is monetizing open source and proving the platform beyond one hit app.
notes: Dealroom and EveryDev list a 125K YC-only round (aggregator, unverified, no round recorded). Founding year not found (aggregator says 2026). The Khoury profile fetch was rate limited, so education is null. The pivot is from search summaries only. Star counts conflict (24K per company, 19.6K per Star History in Sept 2026).
